requirements.notes: 1) A fan can follow only one favorite match at a time; the live score bar shows that match. 2) A blank display name falls back to "Vos". 3) Only video files can be uploaded as a goal celebration; any other file type is rejected with an error message. 4) A fan cannot applaud their own celebration. 5) An uploaded celebration video is published on the wall after moderation; it must not stay "under review" forever. 6) Any signed-in fan can applaud another fan's celebration once, and the applause count goes up by one.
